title: Classification (v1)
description: The triage classifier's routing verdict — the `TriageResult{action, scope, route, confidence}` that src/classifier/classify.py emits and the dispatch loop (Verdict / pipeline._classify) consumes. Today the producer enum-validates internally but consumers re-parse the raw JSON; v1 freezes that boundary. The enums mirror the controlled vocabularies in app/config/tuning.yml (selection.classify.vocab); a vocab change is a content change behind v1, not a schema bump. Versioning discipline mirrors work-order.v1.

action.description: Triage action: one of the ACTIONS vocabulary (implement | decompose | duplicate? | wont-do).

route.description: Model tier the scope maps to.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence (0.0–1.0) that this issue is implementable autonomously.
